svg.title: Figure 1 | A verifiable five-step delegation loop
svg.desc: Four downward arrows show the order within this task. The human accepts, returns corrections or clarifies requirements, returning to specification and contract when necessary. No return edge is drawn; this is not a completed acceptance record.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 1 | A verifiable five-step delegation loop
Define correct behavior and identify confirmed rules.
Specify scope, tools, acceptance and stop conditions.
Operate within actually granted permissions and retain records.
Show file differences, test results and unfinished work.
Accept the result, request corrections or clarify requirements first.
